Spectra of the G3(TTAG3)3 telomeric quadruplex for various DNA concentrations
DNA concentration decreases in the spectra in the order: sp001, sp002, ... sp011

Approximate dilution factors (maximum concentration ~ 200-250 mM in bases)***:

sp001 .. 1
sp002 .. 0.89
sp003 .. 0.80
sp004 .. 0.69
sp005 .. 0.62
sp006 .. 0.50
sp007 .. 0.42
sp008 .. 0.30
sp009 .. 0.21
sp010 .. 0.095
sp011 .. 0.0529

*** Dilution factors were determined from the respective volumes during the dilution of the stock solution
They can also be determined using the intensity of certain DNA bands after normalization to PBS bands
The concentrations of the stock solution and individual samples were determined using absorption spectroscopy

Buffer composition: 150 mM PBS buffer without salt addition
prepared only from potassium phosphates (238.1 mM K+ total).
The PBS buffer was prepared on May 9, 2010
Grating setting: 31900 (31898)
Measurements were carried out at a temperature of 2 °C
Before the start of each measurement, the fluorescence quenching (bleaching) was measured.
